content: अद्रिः [अद्-किन् <ls>Uṇ. 4. 65</ls>; according to <ls>Nir.</ls> <ab>fr.</ab> दॄ to tear or अद् to eat.] .²1 A mountain. .²2 A stone, especially one for pounding Soma with or grinding it on. .²3 A thunderbolt (आदृणाति येन <ls>Nir.</ls>). .²4 A tree. .²5 The sun. <ab>cf.</ab> अद्रिः शैलेऽर्कवृक्षयोः . <ls>Nm.</ls> .²6 A mass of clouds (probably so called from its resemblance to a mountain); a cloud (आदरयितव्यो भवति ह्यसौ उदकार्थं <ls>Nir.</ls>) mostly <ab>Ved.</ab> .²7 A kind of measure. .²8 The number
